jobs.title: Senior Associate, Product Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: Remote (California preferred; other US locations considered); NYC applicants eligible; travel to care centers and hybrid fieldwork required
jobs.why: Build and roll out repeatable workflows, map current processes, eliminate manual work with automation, create dashboards, train front-line users and measure adoption. Audrey has directly relevant Salesforce process improvement, 10+ hours/week saved through contract Flow automation, 90+ users trained, Excel reporting, documentation and monday.com operational workflows.
jobs.gap: Employer prefers California proximity and requires travel/hybrid fieldwork at centers; Audrey has not demonstrated PACE/Medicare/Medicaid care operations, Epic, AI deployment or light scripting. Confirm NYC remote/travel logistics.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.location: Long Island City, NY (work arrangement not stated)
jobs.why: Traditional functional BA role gathering loyalty-program business requirements, drafting user stories and acceptance criteria, coordinating engineering/QA and UAT, and supporting backlog and release planning. Audrey performed these same BA deliverables at Orion with Salesforce and Asana across biweekly sprints.
jobs.gap: Jira and Confluence are explicitly requested but Audrey used Asana/monday.com. Loyalty platform/vendor management and direct consumer loyalty product experience are not established; confirm on-site schedule.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (operational product support)
jobs.salary: $70,000–$110,000 base + bonus/equity; only upper end reaches $100K
jobs.why: Despite the PM title, the published work centers on product operations: user stories, release notes, process guides, KPI reports, sprint logistics, backlog grooming, QA, acceptance criteria, training and launch coordination. Audrey has strong direct Orion experience with these responsibilities and exceeds the 1+ years related-experience threshold.
jobs.gap: Product launch/go-to-market ownership, external integration partners, veterinary technology and customer-feedback synthesis are not established; base salary could fall materially below $100K.

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant - Americas
jobs.location: Remote — United States (NYC salary tier); occasional travel under 5%
jobs.why: Functional enterprise software implementation role translating customer requirements into native platform configurations, developing testing plans before go-live and documenting implementation decisions. Audrey built Salesforce Flows and validation rules, elicited requirements, coordinated UAT and created 20+ Scribe training/migration guides for internal users.
jobs.gap: Requires direct customer-facing complex SaaS implementation experience; Audrey's primary experience was internal Salesforce delivery. Ashby ATS product configuration and external implementation consulting are not established.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (product operations and BA delivery)
jobs.location: Remote — United States; NYC, Philadelphia or Boston preferred
jobs.why: Role is operationally focused despite its PM title: triage requests and defects, refine user stories and acceptance criteria, maintain backlog, coordinate QA/UAT and releases, document workflows and release notes, and support clinical operations users. Audrey did closely analogous Salesforce BA/UAT work and has healthcare-adjacent operational systems work through Horizon Blue ABA.
jobs.gap: Healthcare work is required, preferably clinical software/care delivery. Audrey's healthcare-adjacent ABA operations is not equivalent to oncology care management or EHR experience; she has Asana, not Jira/Linear, and has not owned product strategy.
